name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-japan-title-screen
title: Super Mario World (Japan) - Title Screen
description:
Title Screen and Misc. Layer 3 Objects present in the Japanese Version of SMW. Credit would be appreciated, it was a pain to get these tiles ripped and merged without overwriting the US's english characters.

Note: These Graphics are almost straight from the JP version of the game, you have to rearrange the tiles yourself or use the included .bps file to fix the issue.

This changes:
-The big "SUPER MARIO WORLD" font (duh)
-The Copyright symbol (c)
-The wood borders
-Adds the JP version's ™ symbol (you can still use the US one too)

Hope you enjoy!

Moderator's Note : the set up for the title screen is in the patch provided; there is no known way to export a title screen to a seperate file except by use of an outdated tool. With this is in mind... accepted.
